plan_card.why: Eliminate 'project_root' ambiguity by making repo_root a controller-derived constant and anchoring all paths under it.
plan_card.what: Emit repo_capsule.json and enforce repo-relative paths for helper_created refs, evidence refs, and action path operands.
plan_card.how: Use git rev-parse --show-toplevel in controller; add resolve_under(root, path) helpers; deny traversal/absolute refs.
plan_card.where: Controller/runner path resolution and any verifier that interprets helper_path/gate_decision_ref/prompt_ref.
plan_card.when: Before PLAN/EXEC (PRECHECK) and during CHECK verification

notes: Add repo_capsule.json (repo_root, repo_key, base_ref, base_sha) to evidence or raw, and make it referenced by summary/decision trace.
Enforce that helper_created.helper_path and all {path,sha256} refs are repo-relative and resolve under repo_root (or under out_dir for evidence refs).
Add reason code ROOT_MISMATCH / PATH_ESCAPES_ROOT on violation.
